summary.text: Carrie Tergin is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 59 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Rebecca Kroll.
She served as mayor of Jefferson City from 2015 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Tergin assumed office as mayor of Jefferson City on April 20, 2015, and left office on April 17, 2023; she did not run for re-election in 2023.
She won the August 4, 2026 Republican primary for District 59, defeating Victor Rackers and Glenn Reynolds.
